title: Astronomical Emission Range Finder
statement:
An observatory logs N photon emission frequencies sorted in non-decreasing order.
Given a query frequency T, determine the starting and ending index (0-based) where frequency T appears in the log.
If T does not exist, print -1 -1.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and T.
Second line: N space-separated integers in non-decreasing order.
outputFormat: Print two space-separated integers: first_index last_index.

sampleCases.explanation: Frequency 8 starts at index 3 and ends at index 4.
Frequency 6 is not in the array.
